title: Google announces $5M funding for IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research
summary: The funding will support the institute's researchers and students across three core pillars: advanced AI research, educational opportunities, and AI capacity building.
llm_summary: Google is committing $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to boost its advanced AI initiatives. The grant will fund cutting‑edge research, expand educational programs for students, and help build broader AI expertise across the institute. This partnership aims to position the campus as a regional hub for next‑generation artificial‑intelligence development.
